note: The cars a player can pick in the lobby (P1-C03, R101/R110). Data, any number of rows, no cap. Every row is a drivable vehicle (R123): its profile is assets/profiles/<id>.json and its model is art/vehicles/<id>/; adding a vehicle is a row here plus those two, no code. A row without `art` is drawn as a silhouette in the player's colour (`shape`). Stats are 0-10 bars; the real ones are measured by the sim, not typed (master 7.6). The pick goes to the host in `Pick{vehicle: id, open}` (jj-protocol); the TV names it from this file, and shows an unknown id tidied up. Rows naming the same `spec` are one spec with different bodies (R123): their profiles' tuning must be identical (tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs).

cars.name: Tradie Ute
cars.blurb: Heavy, torquey and tough. Hauls itself out of anything.

cars.name: Hawk Dash
cars.blurb: Rear-drive V8 with twin stripes. Punch it and the tail steps out.

cars.name: Lion President
cars.blurb: The Hawk's old rival: the same V8 and the same grunt under a different body.

cars.name: AU Hawk
cars.blurb: Big round family sedan with a big grin. Loves a burnout and a doughnut, and it is a touch slower.

cars.name: Postie Bike

cars.name: Pig Catcher
